title: Weather, Not Climate
subtitle: Emotional context dynamics in transformer KV-cache geometry: contrast effects, uncertainty scars, and dose-dependent decay
abstract: W_K directional projection reads single-turn emotion at AUROC 0.992 but does not cumulatively accumulate across conversation turns. Instead, emotional context shows contrast dynamics (overshoot at tone shifts), residual uncertainty scars, and dose-dependent decay. System prompts set emotional climate; conversation history provides weather with contrast at fronts.
